summary: binary assets: ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug>|--research] [--extract] | extract <slug> | distill <slug> | link <file> <hub> | list | open <slug>
usage: ops files ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug> | --research] [--extract] | extract <slug> [--reextract] [--heavy] [--lang <x>] [--diarize] [--describe] | distill <slug> | link <file> <hub> | list [--hub <slug>] | open <slug>
hints: The binary-assets plane: ingest routes a file into ~/files + writes a wiki shadow note; extract emits a SIBLING derived note wiki/files/<slug>.extract.md (type extract|transcript, derived_from/source_sha256/tool) from the source bytes via an auto-detected media tier: pdf -> markdown, audio/video/URL -> transcript, image -> OCR/VLM description, txt/md -> plain text. Each tier is an optional dep (pymupdf4llm/docling, mlx-whisper/faster-whisper/parakeet-mlx, yt-dlp, ocrmac/tesseract) that degrades to a one-line install hint instead of crashing; a URL source needs a shadow note whose path: is already the URL (no ingest <url> support yet). distill compiles that extract into 1-N author:agent/status:draft concept notes in wiki/notes/ (typed JSON payload with an agent, heading-outline fallback without; promote via `ops triage drafts`). Same-bytes+same-tool re-run is a no-op; --reextract forces. Common mistake: expecting the binary in git — only the plaintext shadow + extract notes are tracked; and expecting a transcript without the tier's dep installed (it degrades with an install hint).

actions.name: ingest
actions.summary: route a binary into ~/files + write a wiki shadow note (the default action)

args.name: path
args.help: the file to ingest; omit to drain inbox/

args.name: --client
args.help: file under a client hub and link it

args.name: --project
args.help: file under a project hub and link it

args.name: --area
args.help: file under an area hub and link it

args.name: --extract
args.help: chain an extract on each freshly filed asset

actions.name: extract
actions.summary: derive wiki/files/<slug>.extract.md from the source bytes

args.name: --reextract
args.help: force re-extraction even if bytes + tool are unchanged

args.name: --heavy
args.help: allow a heavier extractor tier (e.g. docling for PDF)

args.name: --describe
args.help: add a VLM scene caption for images

actions.name: distill
actions.summary: compile an extract into draft concept notes in wiki/notes/

args.name: slug
args.help: the shadow-note slug whose extract to distill

actions.name: link
actions.summary: attach an already-ingested asset to a hub note

args.name: hub
args.help: the hub note to file it under

args.name: --hub
args.help: only assets filed under this hub

actions.name: open
actions.summary: reveal an asset in Finder via its shadow note
